description:
`FiniteFieldExt::frobenius` panics on two distinct paths and its rustdoc documents one. ## Background `crates/gf2-core/src/field/traits.rs:1105-1107` states a single panic cause: the characteristic failing to convert to `u64`. The exponent computation at `:1126-1129` carries a second, `exp.checked_mul(p).expect("Frobenius exponent overflow")`, which fires whenever $p^k$ exceeds `u64::MAX` — at $k \ge 64$ for the binary carriers and at $k \ge 2$ for `Fp

` with $P > 2^{32}$, which includes `GoldilocksFp`. AGENTS.md requires public-API rustdoc to state its panics. Surfaced twice while authoring the REQ-05 proof sketch of epic `6dc81018`: by the sketch itself (`dev/active/1ac74567/proof-sketch.md` §7.4, with §7.3 giving the mathematical reason the restriction matters) and independently by that issue's doc-review gate as advisory finding F2. Filed rather than fixed in place because issue `1ac74567` changes nothing under `crates/`. ## Success Criteria - [hard] REQ-01: `FiniteFieldExt::frobenius`'s `# Panics` section states both panic causes, naming the exponent-overflow condition in terms of the characteristic and the iteration count. - [hard] REQ-02: The `cargo-ci` gate passes.
title: Document the Frobenius exponent-overflow panic in FiniteFieldExt rustdoc
